purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign028 mechanism without opening a Campaign028 minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Do large or small one-minute price-adjustment magnitudes persist into the next minute inside each continuous trading half, indicating clustered information processing or liquidity demand that may remain relevant from the next open through the third close?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: Higher adjacent persistence in absolute one-minute close returns indicates that price-adjustment intensity arrives in clusters rather than isolated impulses. Ongoing information processing or liquidity demand may therefore carry beyond the signal close into the next three sessions.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Use the 119 adjacent close returns inside 09:31-11:30 and the 119 adjacent close returns inside 13:01-15:00. Form one-step magnitude pairs only inside each half, yielding 118 morning plus 118 afternoon pairs. Exclude standalone 09:30, lunch, overnight, cross-day, and cross-stock transitions.
known_design_risks: absolute versus squared returns, lag length, correlation estimator, direction, zero-return retention, and half-session boundary are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the candidate may be statistically associated with diffusive-variation or variance-entropy factors even though those summarize different aspects of the return-magnitude path
higher magnitude persistence may represent continuing information assimilation or transient volatility clustering, so the higher direction must be frozen before returns
using signed returns, squared returns, ranks, regressions, longer lags, subwindows, market residuals, amount or volume weights, or terminal factor values would change the mechanism

rejected_concepts.reason: This would rescue or reformulate terminal Campaign027 instead of studying adjacent return-magnitude persistence.
Signed adjacency and run counts are too close to the terminal return-sign-run and bar-direction-continuity families.
Squared returns add a discretionary magnitude transform, while range persistence directly reopens the terminal intrabar-range reversal family.
Campaign028 must be one new raw close-path statistic; combining or transforming terminal factors is prohibited.
